title: k-Volume: a Unified Active Learning Strategy
abstract: arXiv:2611.09388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the classification context where revealing the label of a sample is costly, we propose a new Active Learning (AL) strategy named k-Volume (kVol). It randomly selects a sample to be labeled according to the volume of the smallest ball containing its k nearest neighbors. kVol is highly versatile: it can be applied either in the input space or in the output space, and it enjoys the desirable properties of the three main families of AL strategies: density, diversity, and (when performed in the output space) uncertainty. From a theoretical perspective, we establish that kVol is asymptotically equivalent to uniform sampling over the support of the (input or output) data distribution. Based on experiments on various synthetic and real-life tabular datasets and images, we observe that kVol is surprisingly stable: whatever the classifier or the experimental setup, it still lies among the best AL strategies unlike other competitors that fail

translated_title: k-Volume：一种统一的主动学习策略
translated_abstract: 在标注样本标签代价高昂的分类场景中，我们提出了一种名为k-Volume（kVol）的新型主动学习（AL）策略。该策略根据包含样本k个最近邻的最小球体体积，随机选择待标注的样本。kVol具有高度通用性：它既可以应用于输入空间，也可以应用于输出空间，并且兼具主动学习三大主要策略家族的理想特性：密度、多样性以及（在输出空间中执行时的）不确定性。从理论角度，我们证明了kVol在渐近意义上等价于在（输入或输出）数据分布支撑集上的均匀采样。基于多种合成数据集、真实表格数据集和图像的实验，我们观察到kVol具有惊人的稳定性：无论使用何种分类器或实验设置，它始终位列最优的主动学习策略之中，而其他竞争方法则难以做到这一点。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新型主动学习策略k-Volume，通过包含样本k近邻的最小球体体积来选择待标注样本，统一融合了密度、多样性和不确定性三大类主动学习策略的优势，理论上被证明渐近等价于均匀采样，并在各种分类器和实验设置中展现出卓越的稳定性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes k-Volume, a novel active learning strategy that selects samples for labeling based on the volume of the smallest ball containing their k nearest neighbors, unifying the advantages of density, diversity, and uncertainty-based AL strategies, with proven asymptotic equivalence to uniform sampling and remarkable stability across classifiers and experimental settings.
